# Norra Scores AI Context

Norra Scores is a modern, progressively enhanced web application providing live sports scores, match details, and standings across various top leagues like the Premier League, LaLiga, and Champions League. 

Features:
- Real-time match status (LIVE, FT, HT).
- Deep match stats (shots, possession, cards).
- Live push notifications (simulated locally).
- Offline capabilities (PWA).
- Knowledge Base / Chatbot capabilities.

Tech Stack:
- React 18, React Router DOM, Vite
- Tailwind CSS
- SWR (Stale-While-Revalidate) for data fetching
- LocalStorage for preferences
